# Oladimeji Abubakar

> Oladimeji Abubakar, also known as uxdimeji, is a product designer and UI/UX designer based in Kwara and working across Nigeria and worldwide.

Canonical website: https://uxdimeji.com
Based in: Kwara
Country: Nigeria
Availability: Kwara, across Nigeria, and worldwide
Experience: More than five years in product and UI/UX design
Contact: oladimejiuiux@gmail.com

## About

Oladimeji is a product designer in Kwara who works with teams across Nigeria and worldwide. He designs intuitive digital products from strategy and user experience through interface design, design systems, prototyping, and development. His portfolio includes SaaS, fintech, healthcare, and marketplace product work.

## Core Specializations
- Product design and UI/UX design
- Design systems and component architecture
- User research and journey mapping
- Interaction design and prototyping
- SaaS and digital product design
- Functional prototyping and builds
- Design-to-development collaboration
